title: Memory vault Doctor: misplaced facts and competing legacy output (#1389)
body:
Fixes #1389.

I added a bounded, read-only walk in `memory-vault.js` (`scanHygiene`, surfaced as `getStatus().findings` as `{ kind, path, why, fix }` with vault-relative paths) and Doctor now warns per finding kind.

What it finds:
- fact-shaped notes (a valid header with Mana's `status`) outside Facts/, Facts/Pending and Facts/Archived, which are silently ignored today
- missing Facts folders (and Views/ when views are enabled), only after the vault has synced once
- an old top-level `Mana Memory.md`
- Views files without Mana's marker

Legacy and Reference folders (any case) are never looked into, nor are dot folders and Journal/. Doctor explains that marked Views files are Mana's and get rewritten, unmarked ones are mine and never overwritten, and that nothing is imported, moved or deleted. A reorganised vault with extra folders and plain notes stays healthy.

Bounds: 1000 entries, 4 levels deep, 50 findings, only .md files under 8 KB are read. Hitting the entry cap adds a note to the Doctor message.

Left out: entity-noise growth. There is no cheap data for it yet; it depends on #1387 (PR #1395). Also not covered: a fact-shaped note with no `status` header can't be told apart from an ordinary note, and unreadable subfolders are skipped silently.

Tests added in `test/memory-vault.test.js` and `test/doctor.test.js`; I did not run them locally, CI does.
interface: The merged change for PR #1396 is covered by test/doctor.test.js, test/memory-vault.test.js.
why: Additional real merged-fix benchmark case selected to broaden the agentic coding evaluation.
